content: 1. Cheng WH, Xie LH, Huang SJ, and Lu HK conducted a randomized controlled trial comparing ceftriaxone sodium and spectinomycin hydrochloride for the treatment of uncomplicated gonorrhea. (J Clin Dermatol, 2001;30(3):186) 2. Davidson AJ and Judson FN investigated the challenges in curing anorectal gonorrhea in women, questioning whether it is more difficult to treat than other forms. (Sex Transm Dis, 1986) 3. Duančić A, Fiumara NJ, Alpert S, Lee YH, Tarr PI, Rosner B, et al. compared the efficacy of spectinomycin hydrochloride and aqueous procaine penicillin G in treating uncomplicated gonorrhea. (Antimicrob Agents Chemother) 4. Duncan WC, Holder WR, Roberts DP, and Knox JM evaluated the treatment of gonorrhea with spectinomycin hydrochloride and compared it to standard penicillin regimens. (Antimicrob Agents Chemother) 5. Finger AH studied the use of spectinomycin in treating gonorrhea in both male and female patients. (Br J Vener Dis) 6. Handsfield HH and Murphy VL conducted a comparative study of ceftriaxone and spectinomycin for treating uncomplicated gonorrhea in men. (Lancet) 7. Holder WR, Roberts DP, Duncan WC, and Knox JM presented a preliminary report on the use of spectinomycin HCl for treating gonorrhea in homosexual men. (Br J Vener Dis) 8. Hook EW 3rd, Judson FN, Verdon MS, Ehret JM, and Handsfield HH compared cefoperazone and spectinomycin for treating uncomplicated gonorrhea in men. (Antimicrob Agents Chemother) 9. Jaffe HW, Reynolds GH, and Wiesner PJ conducted a national gonorrhea therapy monitoring study, focusing on adverse drug reactions. (J Am Vener Dis Assoc) 10. Judson FN, Allaman J, and Dans PE compared the efficacy of penicillin G procaine, doxycycline, spectinomycin, and ampicillin in treating gonorrhea. (JAMA) 11. Judson FN, Ehret JM, and Root CJ compared ceftriaxone and aqueous procaine penicillin G for treating uncomplicated gonorrhea in women. (Antimicrob Agents Chemother) 12. Karney WW, Pedersen AH, Nelson M, Adams H, and Pfeifer RT compared spectinomycin and tetracycline for treating gonorrhea. (WHO Guidelines) 13. Kim JH compared thiamphenicol and spectinomycin in treating uncomplicated gonorrhea in men. (Sex Transm Dis) 14. Kojima M, Masuda K, Yada Y, Hayase Y, Muratani T, and Matsumoto T evaluated single-dose treatment of male patients with gonococcal urethritis using 2g spectinomycin, focusing on microbiological and clinical outcomes. (Int J Antimicrob Agents) 15. Kousa M, Lassus A, Järveläinen R, and Renkonen OV studied the use of spectinomycin hydrochloride in treating uncomplicated gonorrhea in both males and females. (Br J Vener Dis) 16. McCann JS, Horner T, Shepherd I, Quin N, and Dougan H evaluated the use of spectinomycin hydrochloride (Trobicin) in treating gonorrhea. (Ir Med J) 17. Meheus A, Widy-Wirski R, D’Costa J, Van Dyck E, Delgadillo R, and Piot P studied the treatment of gonorrhea in males in the Central African Republic using spectinomycin and procaine penicillin. (Bull World Health Organ) 18. Meyer-Rohn J reported on the minute treatment of gonorrhea with spectinomycin. (Z Hautkr, in German) 19. Monayar HK, Ledesma A, Nobile V, and Viarengo JA analyzed the epidemiology and treatment of uncomplicated gonorrhea caused by non-PPNG strains in Córdoba, Argentina, including auxotypes, susceptibility profiles, and plasmid analyses of urethral isolates from men. (Genitourin Med) 20. Panikabutra K, Ariyarit C, Chitwarakorn A, and Saensano C evaluated cefaclor and cefamandole as alternatives to spectinomycin for treating men with uncomplicated gonorrhea. (Br J Vener Dis) 21. Panikabutra K, Lee CT, Ho B, and Bamberg P analyzed the efficacy and patient preferences for single-dose oral norfloxacin or intramuscular spectinomycin in treating gonorrhea (PPNG and non-PPNG infections). (Genitourin Med) 22. Pedersen AH, Wiesner PJ, Holmes KK, Johnson CJ, and Turck M conducted a comparative evaluation of spectinomycin and penicillin G in treating gonorrhea. (JAMA) 23. Porter IA and Rutherford HW studied the treatment of uncomplicated gonorrhea with spectinomycin hydrochloride (Trobicin). (Br J Vener Dis) 24. Ratnam AV, Patel MI, Hira SK, and Mulenga RC compared penicillin and spectinomycin in treating gonococcal urethritis. (Sex Transm Dis) 25. Sands M focused on the treatment of anorectal gonorrhea infections in men. (JAMA) 26. Shams-ur-Rehman Khan A, Amanullah, and Akhter K evaluated the clinical efficacy of various drugs used in treating gonorrhea. (J Ayub Med Coll Abbottabad) 27. Shi D compared the clinical efficacy of sparfloxacin and spectinomycin in treating gonorrhea. (Chinese J Antibiotics, in Chinese) 28. Stapinski A and Gede K provided further observations on treating gonorrhea with spectinomycin. (Przegl Dermatol, in Polish) 29. Stratigos JD, Marsellou-Kinti O, Kassimatis V, and Daikos GK studied the treatment of gonorrhea with spectinomycin hydrochloride. (Br J Vener Dis) 30. Tian HQ reported on the use of ceftriaxone in treating 115 patients with gonorrhea. (Chinese J New Drugs Clinical Remedies, in Chinese) 31. Tupasi T, Crisolgo LB, Torres CA, and Calubiran OV compared spectinomycin, cefuroxime, thiamphenicol, and penicillin G in treating uncomplicated gonococcal infections in women. (J Infect Dis) 32. Tupasi TE, Vizconde LC, Torres CA, and Calubiran OV evaluated thiamphenicol in treating gonococcal infections, comparing it with penicillin and spectinomycin. (Sex Transm Dis) 33. Tuz F and Hatos G studied the treatment of male urethral gonorrhea with spectinomycin hydrochloride (Trobicin). (Med J Aust) 34. Willcox RR evaluated the use of spectinomycin in treating gonorrhea in males. (Br J Vener Dis) 35. Wójtowicz U, Napiorkowska T, Stapinski A, and Przedpelska G analyzed the incidence and treatment outcomes of beta-lactamase-positive gonorrhea with spectinomycin (Trobicin). (Przegl Dermatol, in Polish) 36. Zhou YS, Tao R, Wang EP, and Jiang SC observed the clinical use of etimicin sulfate and spectinomycin in treating gonorrhea.
